settings.themeSub: Light or dark color scheme (applies immediately).
settings.aiSub: Locally via Ollama or online via Google Gemini (API key required).
settings.ollamaSub: Local language model for recommendations and the chat assistant.
settings.ollamaDisableReasoningHint: Saved immediately when toggled. Matches Ollama API (0.20+): top-level think: false right after model. Also augments the system prompt. Some builds still ignore the flag. For gpt-oss, only low/medium/high.
settings.noModels: ⚠ No models found. Pull one e.g.
settings.modelNotChosen: No model selected — the app will use
settings.modelNotChosen2: automatically. Pick a model above to pin it.
settings.modelMissingWarn2: is not installed. Pick one above or run
settings.toolModelsTitle: Recommended models for targeted data retrieval
settings.toolModelsHint: These models support Ollama tools, so the assistant loads only the study data needed for each question.
settings.geminiSub: Data is sent to Google Generative Language API. Only store your key here if you accept a locally saved API key; rotate compromised keys in the
settings.apiKeyPlaceholder: From Google AI Studio (or GEMINI_API_KEY in environment)
settings.apiKeyHint: Alternative: set key only via env var
settings.apiKeyHint2: when starting Electron — leave field empty.
settings.qs1: Install Ollama (ollama.ai) — it runs in the background
settings.qs2: Pull a tool-capable model, e.g. ollama pull qwen3:8b
settings.qs3: Use “Load models” above and select one
settings.qs4: “Test connection” — then use recommendations and chat
settings.targetEctsError: Must be a number between 0 and 360.
settings.targetGpaError: Must be a number between 1.0 and 4.0.
settings.backupSub: Export all data or restore from a backup file.

chat.title: AI assistant
chat.ipcStaleMain: Chat saving is not active in the Electron main process (common after an update). Quit the app completely (close all windows) and restart with “npm run dev” or from the app icon.
chat.retrievalFallbackBody: This model does not reliably support targeted tool calls. Responses still work but may be slower. Recommended tool-capable models:
chat.emptyText: I know your exams, lectures, and tasks and can give personal tips for organizing your studies.

chat.sug2: Create a study plan for my next exam.
chat.sug3: How much time do I have until the next exam?
chat.sug4: Help me sort my open tasks sensibly.

onboarding.step1Title: Welcome to the TUM Study Portal!
onboarding.step1Body: This dashboard helps you organize your studies at TUM. Let’s take a quick look at the key areas.
onboarding.step2Body: See your next exams, to-dos, and AI model status in one place.
onboarding.step3Body: Ask questions about your studies, create study plans, or summarize tasks — fully local and private.
onboarding.step4Body: Import your personal iCal link from TUMonline to see your lectures automatically.
onboarding.step5Body: Connect your courses to Moodle links and keep track of weekly sessions.
onboarding.step6Body: Get started with your personal iCal link from TUMonline. The import opens only after you click “Import timetable”.
